answer: Similarity merging collapses fake keys into one identity. Every epoch the network builds a trellis, a public graph linking keys whose answers share 80% of their 5-word shingles. A group linked for 3 straight epochs is merged into one payout, and each extra key forfeits its basalt, the 50 POA bond locked at registration. A sable list of merged keys is published so anyone can verify each merge. A farm of 1,000 fakes templating answers forfeits 999 x 50 POA = 49,950 POA. Attacker pays 49,950 POA.
